findings.detail: In the scenario the coordinator delegates and a dedicated subagent searches the web. The question has the coordinator agent's own loop run the web search directly. Option D also treats the search as a coordinator tool, separate from the subagents. This contradicts the story's division of roles. The stem should place the loop in the web search subagent, or make the coordinator's tool call a delegation to the search subagent.

blind_answer.reason: The loop discards the search output, so Claude never sees its findings and keeps requesting the same search. Appending each output to the conversation history as a tool_result lets Claude reason over the new information on the next iteration. Option A (phrase parsing) and option B (an iteration cap) are both termination anti-patterns that don't address the cause. Option D gives up model-driven decisions instead of fixing the missing results.
